name: 5-Ingredient Black Bean Soup

ingredients.name: chipotle chilis, canned in adobo sauce, finely chopped
homemade chicken stock, plus more as needed, divided

instructions.primary_message: In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium-high until shimmering. Add onions, and cook, stirring occasionally, until just softened, about 5 minutes. Add chipotle chile and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Stir in black beans and their liquid, lime zest and juice, salt, and 1 cup of the broth; bring to a simmer. Once at a simmer, reduce to medium-low. Cover and cook, undisturbed, until the flavors meld and the mixture is slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.

Uncover, and using a potato masher, mash about 3/4 of the beans. Increase heat to medium-high, and stir in remaining 1/2 cup of broth. Continue to cook until mixture is creamy and thickened, 2 to 5 minutes. Thin to the desired texture with additional broth, if needed.
Serve immediately with optional lime wedge, sour cream, cilantro, scallions, or crumbled cotija cheese, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: black bean soup recipe, 5-ingredient black bean soup

description: Black bean soup using canned beans doesn't have to taste rushed. This five-ingredient recipe delivers rich flavor and creamy texture in under 30 minutes.
notes:
Optional substitutions: white onion → yellow onion; homemade chicken stock → vegetable stock or store-bought low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth

Make-ahead and storage: Leftover soup can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Leah Colins
